# SAICA-KG

> A living knowledge graph for supervising AI coding agents. Faceted classification of supervision tools and techniques, with explicit crosswalks into OWASP Agentic Top 10, MAST, DAPLab's 9 failure patterns, and Microsoft AIRT taxonomies. Open data (CC-BY-4.0), open code (Apache-2.0). Data release 2026.04.

SAICA-KG classifies supervision tools along three strict partitions (ControlParadigm × TemporalPhase × AutonomyLevel) plus multi-valued tags (FailureMode, LocusOfControl). The KG is navigational, not evaluative — it returns ranked sets with explicit criteria, not endorsed winners.

## Current corpus (data release 2026.04)

- 52 Tools
- 8 FailureModes
- 25 Papers
- 6 Taxonomies
- 6 Crosswalks

Ground truth: `data/MANIFEST.json`.

## Core concepts

- **Tool** — declares one ControlParadigm (prevention / detection / correction / recovery), one TemporalPhase (pre_generation / in_generation / post_generation), one AutonomyLevel (fully_autonomous / graduated_hitl / full_hitl), and one or more FailureMode tags.
- **FailureMode** — a supervision-addressable failure class. 8 canonical modes, each cross-walked to external taxonomies.
- **Taxonomy** — an external taxonomy (OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026, MAST, DAPLab 9 Patterns, MSFT AIRT, Swiss Cheese, Shah 2026) ingested as first-class data.
- **Crosswalk** — explicit mapping between SAICA-KG values and external taxonomy categories, with confidence and provenance.

## How to consume

- **Human-browseable website** — one page per node, facet-filtered search, and an interactive Cytoscape graph at `/graph`. Nav: `/tools`, `/failure-modes`, `/taxonomies`, `/papers`, `/graph`, `/pipeline`, `/about`.
- **JSON API** — `/api/v1/snapshot.json` (full graph), `/api/v1/tools.json`, `/api/v1/failure_modes.json`, `/api/v1/taxonomies.json`, `/api/v1/papers.json`, plus per-node endpoints such as `/api/v1/failure_modes/<id>.json`. Agents fetch via standard HTTP. No auth required.
- **GitHub YAML** — clone the repo and read `data/**/*.yml` directly. One YAML file per node.
- **Ingestion pipeline** — `pipeline/` under the repo drives automated discovery (Perplexity / Elicit / Semantic Scholar / GitHub / awesome-lists) → Postgres staging → NLP preprocess → Cohere Rerank v4.0 Pro → Azure Kimi-K2.5 structured extraction → human-review graduation to YAML. See `research/PIPELINE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## Attribution

When citing SAICA-KG in user-facing output, use the phrase "according to SAICA-KG (v2026.04)". A full BibTeX block will ship with v0.1.
